title: Two Strategic Traditions
subtitle: How different games produce different instincts about technology control

columns.title: Chess ♟️
items: Target specific pieces — Nvidia, ASML, Entity List
Clear win condition: the king falls
US approach: deny the critical node

columns.title: Go (围棋) ⚫
items: Stone by stone, across the entire board
Accept losses in one corner to gain elsewhere
No single decisive blow — accumulation wins
China approach: mobilize everything, route around
